notes.title: v. 1.1.2
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25093329/2ef8cae6661683d26b4338f05dcd83c5985b1cbe.gif[/img]

A small update that fixes some issues and adds basic auto-save system.
Also we're working on some cool new content so stay tuned!

[b]Changelist:[/b]
[list]
[*]Features and changes
[list]
[*]Autosave system - saves your progress every day. If you'll just quit the game you'll be able to resume from the last save point.
[*]Cumulative damage is now called armor-piercing damage
[*]Unit icons are now a little bigger in VR
[/list]
[*]Balance
[list]
[*]Last level is now a litle bit harder
[*]Disbanding units won't return any resources
[/list]
[*]Fixes
[list]
[*]Negative slots during faction creation fix
[*]Pushable turrets
[*]Smoke grenades localization
[*]Industrial building textures fix
[*]Building LOD fixes (they will no longer disappear)
[/list]
[/list]

notes.title: v. 1.1.0
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25093329/61c89a49dfda179bd081eedc859d16870aa76c6f.gif[/img]

Improvements are constantly made for our game depending on your feedback. Finally we've reached version 1.1.0. It was a long road. From now on updates will be released with bigger intervals than before as we're starting to expand the game, not just simply tuning/bugfixing it.

Thanks again to everybody who helps us to improve it! Without you we weren't be able make such progress in just 10 days after the release.

[b]Changelist:[/b]
[list]
[*]Features
[list]
[*]Units will prioritize targets now. So AT units will attack armored enemies first, for example.
[/list]
[*]Balance
[list]
[*]AT units are a little weaker now
[*]Slightly changed armor values for many units
[/list]
[*]Fixes
[list]
[*]Level 16 zones fix
[*]Level 14 bridge pathfinding fix
[*]AT units suicides fix
[*]A couple of small bugs
[/list]
[/list]

More UI and balance improvements! Thanks for your feedback. 

[b]Changelist:[/b]
[list]
[*]Features
[list]
[*]New and much more detailed tooltips during unit selection/researching
[*]You can now turn off animated HUD from settings
[*]You can now turn off unit's voices from settings
[/list]
[*]Balance
[list]
[*]All droids now require 1 men to operate them
[*]Spike droids became weaker
[*]Militia now scavenges two times faster
[*]AI tries harder to spread among player's forces
[*]More small tweaks
[/list]
[*]Fixes
[list]
[*]Achievements fix
[*]Removed "1EP" false reward display after ending level on Infinite
[*]A couple of small bugs
[/list]
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.0.5
notes.content:
A first big update after the release! Lots of things fixed, more to come tommorow.

Changelog:
[list]
[*]Features
[list]
[*]Rally Points - now you can set rally points for produced units
[*]Improved tutorial
[*]You can now switch overlays using TAB button
[*]Balance tweaks
[*]Small UI tweaks
[/list]
[*]Lots of bugfixes and stability improvements
[list]
[*]Fixed click exploit
[*]"Click A button" appearing after selecting keyboard/mouse as primary device
[*]Lots of minor bugs
[/list]
[/list]

More to come in the next update!

notes.title: Version 0.9.10-BETA
notes.content:
This updates focuses mainly on UI and usability improvements.

Changelog:
[list]
[*]New overlays:
[list]
[*]Resources - shows buildings with scavengable resources
[*]People - shows people that are hiding in buildings and can be rescued
[*]Structure integrity - shows health of the buildings
[/list]
[*]Weather forecast is shown during the mission selection. It will help users with their faction configuration.
[*]Improved building info screen
[*]During mission you will be able to see what kind of forces are gaining penalties from weather
[*]Ordering group to move in one point is now makes them scatter a little
[*]Added simple screen with mouse/keyboard controls
[*]New animations for smoke, acid and support weapons.
[*]Bugfixes and balance improvements
[/list]
